Subject: Post-demo: buying committee recap & next steps

Hi Samantha, Tom —

Thanks again for carving out time today for the demo and buying-committee session. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Who we heard / decision roles (as we understood them)
- Economic buyer: Tom Hensley (VP Product) — cares most about unit economics and predictable latency.
- Technical/compliance reviewer: Samantha Ortiz (Head of Security) — needs SOC 2 artifacts, data handling guarantees, and network architecture.
- Procurement: TBD (Samantha mentioned there may be a centralized procurement contact).
- Day-to-day users: AI Platform and Product teams (we met several engineers today).

2) Decision criteria you called out
- End-to-end latency SLA for interactive features (p95 under 400ms)
- Clear cost model and ability to cap spend by route
- SOC 2 / audit evidence and KMS integration for keys
- Flexibility to run private deployment behind your VPC if needed

3) Immediate asks we captured (attached)
- Proposal (attached: RWI-proposal-v2.pdf) — includes committed throughput pricing and optional private deployment add-on.
- SOC2 / evidence checklist (attached: SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx) — please flag any items you need sooner.
- Demo recording & architecture slides: https://drive.google.com/finserv-demo-recording

4) Proposed next steps
- Samantha: confirm procurement contact + timeline for procurement (we asked for who manages PO and contract reviews).
- Tom: confirm economic owner approval timeline (you mentioned end of Q1 goal).
- Redwood (Ben + Dev + me): prepare a 1-page deployment summary (SSO, data flow, encryption) + a short answers doc for SOC2 questions by EOD Wed 3/4.
- Schedule: propose a 30-min PO/contract review week of 3/9 — Ben to propose times.

If I missed anything obvious or if the roles are off, please correct me. Happy to loop in legal/procurement contacts directly once you share names.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
